characteristics.name: active rift enhancement
characteristics.$text:
Command Relay:
When a Mk IIC Automated Director uses the Snap to Action! ability, it may use this enhancement. The Automated Director may issue Orders to up to two units with the Computational Systems special rule anywhere on the table, rather than within 6". If this Rift Enhancement is used, exhaust one of the Automated Director's Rift Dice after it has executed its own Order.

characteristics.name: surging bonus
characteristics.$text: Lose the Lumbering special rule. When using the Snap to Action! ability, the Automated Director may issue Orders to up to 3 friendly units.

characteristics.name: exhausted penalty
characteristics.$text: May not be issued Run Orders. May not use the Snap to Action! ability
